title: Field Service & Inspection Work Order PDF
shortDescription: Generate field technician service and inspection work order PDFs from scheduled Google Sheets rows, store them in Drive, and update status and PDF links.
setupSteps: Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Work_Orders Sheet to create the tab with standard columns.

Add placeholders {{Work_Order_ID}}, {{Site_Name}}, {{Technician_Name}}, {{Scheduled_Date}}, {{Scope_Of_Work}}, and {{Generated_At}} to your Google Docs work order template, then save Template & Folder IDs.
Set ready dispatch rows to Scheduled in the Status column and run SheetAutomate > Generate Scheduled Work Order PDFs.

sampleRows: Inspect HVAC chiller compressor seals and calibrate glycol sensors
Replace backup UPS battery bank and run load transfer test
Annual fire suppression valve pressure inspection

fields.label: Scope of Work
fields.defaultValue: Inspect HVAC chiller compressor seals and calibrate glycol sensors

demo.outputSubtitle: Work order PDF saved to Drive; Status updated to Dispatched
demo.auditColumn: Col F (Status), Col G (PDF_Link) & Col H (Audit_Status)
